_comment: Single source of truth for the ChemDFT SOFTWARE citation. Read by apps/web/src/lib/citation.ts and chemdft_api/citation_block.py. 'version' and 'date_released' must equal the newest entry of apps/web/src/content/releases.ts, release_info.py, CITATION.cff and .zenodo.json (tests enforce it). 'doi' is the all-versions (concept) DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24082321. The version DOI for the 0.0.26 open-core snapshot is 10.5281/zenodo.24082322 (Zenodo record https://zenodo.org/records/24082322).
title: ChemDFT
abstract: Computational chemistry workbench where an AI Scientist plans and explains and every scientific value comes from a verified engine.
